title: ADHD Test Ireland | Free Adult ADHD Screening
description: Take the six-question adult ADHD screener (ASRS v1.1 Part A) and see what your answers mean. A screening result is not a diagnosis — only a psychiatrist or clinical psychologist can make one.
h2: What ADHD looks like in adults
What this screen cannot tell you
Want to talk your result through?

schemaFaqs.question: Can an online ADHD test diagnose ADHD?
schemaFaqs.answer: No, and no online questionnaire can. This is a screener: it sorts people into "worth assessing properly" and "not on these answers". A diagnosis is made by a psychiatrist or a clinical psychologist, from a full interview about your history rather than from six questions.

schemaFaqs.question: What is the ASRS?
schemaFaqs.answer: The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale, developed with the World Health Organization. Part A is the six-question screener used here; the full scale has eighteen items. It is the most widely used adult ADHD screening instrument, which is why clinicians recognise the result you bring them.

schemaFaqs.question: What counts as a positive result?
schemaFaqs.answer: Four or more of the six questions answered at or above that question's own threshold. The first three count from "Sometimes", the last three only from "Often" — the thresholds differ because the questions do, and a single flat cut-off would miss the inattentive presentation.

schemaFaqs.question: Can I have ADHD if my result is negative?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Six questions cannot cover a condition that presents differently at different ages and in different people, and the inattentive presentation in particular is under-detected — one reason women are diagnosed later and less often. If the difficulties are affecting your life, a negative screen is not a reason to stop asking.

schemaFaqs.question: Who can diagnose ADHD?
schemaFaqs.answer: A psychiatrist or a clinical psychologist, depending on the country. A GP is normally where the process starts: they take the history, rule out the conditions that mimic ADHD — thyroid problems, sleep disorders, anxiety, depression — and refer you on for the assessment itself.

schemaFaqs.question: Does this ADHD test store my answers?
schemaFaqs.answer: No. The scoring runs entirely in your browser. Nothing you select is sent to our servers or saved.

schemaFaqs.question: How do I get assessed for ADHD in Ireland?
schemaFaqs.answer: Through a GP first. Adult ADHD is assessed by psychiatrists and clinical psychologists, whether that happens in the public mental health services or privately, and a GP referral is what starts either route. The GP also checks the things that can look like ADHD, such as thyroid function, sleep problems, anxiety and depression, before anyone assesses for it.

schemaFaqs.question: Can I be prescribed ADHD medication from an online test?
schemaFaqs.answer: No, and be wary of anywhere that offers it. ADHD medicines are controlled drugs, started only after a full assessment and a diagnosis by a specialist, and prescribing afterwards is normally shared between that specialist and your GP. Our Irish-registered doctors can review a screening result, rule out the conditions that mimic ADHD and refer you on. They cannot diagnose it in a video call.

Nothing here is a recommendation for medication.01How the screen is scoredThe questions are Part A of the World Health Organization's Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale — the short form used to decide whether a full assessment is worth arranging, rather than the assessment itself.Scoring is per question, not a running total. Each item has its own threshold, and four or more items reaching their own threshold is a positive screen. Treating it as a flat "four answers of Often" rule is the usual mistake, and it misses the inattentive presentation, which is the one most often overlooked in adults.1What it asks aboutFinishing the last details of a projectCounts fromSometimes2What it asks aboutGetting things in order for a taskCounts fromSometimes3What it asks aboutRemembering appointments and commitmentsCounts fromSometimes4What it asks aboutPutting off tasks that take a lot of thoughtCounts fromOften5What it asks aboutFidgeting when you have to stay seatedCounts fromOften6What it asks aboutFeeling restlessly driven to keep goingCounts fromOftenThe six screening questions and the answer each one counts fromQuestionWhat it asks aboutCounts from1Finishing the last details of a projectSometimes2Getting things in order for a taskSometimes3Remembering appointments and commitmentsSometimes4Putting off tasks that take a lot of thoughtOften5Fidgeting when you have to stay seatedOften6Feeling restlessly driven to keep goingOftenFour or more questions at or above their own threshold is a positive screen. The scale was developed for adults from 18 onwards and is not a children's screener.02What ADHD looks like in adultsAdult ADHD rarely looks like the classroom picture. Hyperactivity often turns inward — restlessness, a mind that will not settle — while the inattentive side stays and gets expensive: missed deadlines, unopened admin, a working memory that keeps dropping things.What matters for a diagnosis is that the difficulties are long-standing, show up in more than one part of life, and cause real impairment. Everyone loses their keys occasionally; that is not what is being asked.Starting tasks that matter, and finishing the ones that have stopped being interesting.Time: underestimating it, losing it, arriving late despite genuinely trying not to.Organisation — paperwork, bills, appointments — costing far more effort than it seems to cost other people.Restlessness, or a constant low-level need to be doing something.Interrupting, blurting things out, or acting on an idea before thinking it through.Emotions that arrive fast and pass fast, often out of proportion to what caused them.03What this screen cannot tell youA six-question screener is a sorting tool. It is deliberately quick and deliberately over-inclusive, because its job is to decide who should be assessed properly — not to decide who has ADHD.It is not a diagnosis, and a positive result on its own means no more than "worth assessing".A negative result does not rule ADHD out, particularly for the inattentive presentation and particularly in women, who are diagnosed later and less often.Anxiety, depression, poor sleep, thyroid disease, chronic pain and heavy drinking all produce the same answers.It cannot separate ADHD from autism, from a specific learning difficulty, or from the effects of a long stretch of stress.It was designed and validated for adults. Children and teenagers need a different assessment entirely.It says nothing about treatment. Medication is one option among several, and it is only ever considered after a diagnosis.04Getting properly assessedA diagnosis of ADHD is made by a psychiatrist or a clinical psychologist. The assessment is a structured clinical interview covering your history from childhood onwards, usually with rating scales and, where possible, an account from someone who has known you a long time.Start with a doctor. They will go through your history, check for the conditions that look like ADHD, and refer you for assessment.Bring specifics rather than a score: school reports, work reviews, the things that keep going wrong and how long they have been going wrong for.Say what else is going on — sleep, mood, alcohol, thyroid, a past head injury. Those change both the assessment and the order it happens in.A screening result is a starting point for that conversation, not a substitute for it. Take yours with you.If you are struggling to cope, or having thoughts of harming yourself, contact a doctor or the emergency services now rather than waiting for an assessment.Where to go from hereA screening result is a reason to get assessed, not a diagnosis. These are the consultations that can take it further.View service: Psychiatry Specialist Consultation in Ireland€250Psychiatry Specialist Consultation in IrelandSpeak with an IMC-registered consultant psychiatrist via secure video call. Expert psychiatric assessment, diagnosis review, and mental health management. Same-day appointments available.45 minView service: Psychiatry Specialist Consultation in IrelandBook Consultation: Psychiatry Specialist Consultation in IrelandView service: Online GP consultationOnline GP consultationTalk any result through with a registered doctor by video, and get the checks a calculator cannot give you.View service: Online GP consultationBook Consultation: Online GP consultationMore free calculatorsBMI calculatorBody mass index from your height and weight, on the WHO adult scale.Open calculatorCalorie calculatorHow many calories a day you need to maintain, lose or gain weight.Open calculatorBlood pressure chartWhat your two numbers mean on the European adult blood pressure chart.Open calculatorDue date calculatorYour estimated due date, how far along you are, and the weeks that matter in between.Open calculatorOvulation calculatorYour fertile window, your estimated ovulation day and when your next period is due.Open calculatorOsteoporosis risk checkerWhich published risk factors for a fragility fracture apply to you, and whether it's worth asking for a bone density scan.Open calculatorSore throat checkerWhether a sore throat looks bacterial or viral, using the age-adjusted score clinicians use — plus the warning signs that need seeing today.Open calculatorQuestionsADHD test: FAQsCan an online ADHD test diagnose ADHD?No, and no online questionnaire can. This is a screener: it sorts people into "worth assessing properly" and "not on these answers". A diagnosis is made by a psychiatrist or a clinical psychologist, from a full interview about your history rather than from six questions.What is the ASRS?The Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale, developed with the World Health Organization. Part A is the six-question screener used here; the full scale has eighteen items. It is the most widely used adult ADHD screening instrument, which is why clinicians recognise the result you bring them.What counts as a positive result?Four or more of the six questions answered at or above that question's own threshold. The first three count from "Sometimes", the last three only from "Often" — the thresholds differ because the questions do, and a single flat cut-off would miss the inattentive presentation.Can I have ADHD if my result is negative?Yes. Six questions cannot cover a condition that presents differently at different ages and in different people, and the inattentive presentation in particular is under-detected — one reason women are diagnosed later and less often. If the difficulties are affecting your life, a negative screen is not a reason to stop asking.Who can diagnose ADHD?A psychiatrist or a clinical psychologist, depending on the country. A GP is normally where the process starts: they take the history, rule out the conditions that mimic ADHD — thyroid problems, sleep disorders, anxiety, depression — and refer you on for the assessment itself.Does this ADHD test store my answers?No. The scoring runs entirely in your browser. Nothing you select is sent to our servers or saved.How do I get assessed for ADHD in Ireland?Through a GP first. Adult ADHD is assessed by psychiatrists and clinical psychologists, whether that happens in the public mental health services or privately, and a GP referral is what starts either route. The GP also checks the things that can look like ADHD, such as thyroid function, sleep problems, anxiety and depression, before anyone assesses for it.Can I be prescribed ADHD medication from an online test?No, and be wary of anywhere that offers it. ADHD medicines are controlled drugs, started only after a full assessment and a diagnosis by a specialist, and prescribing afterwards is normally shared between that specialist and your GP. Our Irish-registered doctors can review a screening result, rule out the conditions that mimic ADHD and refer you on. They cannot diagnose it in a video call.Want to talk your result through?Book a video consultation with a registered doctor, go through your history and the conditions that can look like ADHD, and find out what an assessment would involve.Book a consultation

title: Calculadora de calorias Portugal | Calorias diárias
description: Calcule quantas calorias precisa por dia para manter, perder ou ganhar peso. Equação de Mifflin-St Jeor e cinco níveis de atividade. Valor orientativo.
h2: O que significam os seus números de calorias
Como escolher o seu nível de atividade
O que uma calculadora de calorias não lhe diz
Quer um plano e não só um número?

schemaFaqs.question: Quantas calorias devo comer por dia?
schemaFaqs.answer: As que gasta, se o seu peso já estiver onde quer. Na maioria dos adultos isso fica entre 1.800 e 2.800 kcal, mas o intervalo é largo porque depende do tamanho, da idade e da atividade. A calculadora acima dá-lhe o seu próprio valor em vez da média.

schemaFaqs.question: Quantas calorias preciso de comer para emagrecer?
schemaFaqs.answer: Cerca de 500 kcal por dia abaixo da manutenção dão sensivelmente meio quilo por semana, e 250 abaixo dão cerca de um quarto de quilo. Défices maiores não funcionam de forma fiável mais depressa — são apenas mais difíceis de manter e mais perda vem do músculo.

schemaFaqs.question: 1.200 calorias por dia é seguro?
schemaFaqs.answer: É a ingestão mais baixa que esta calculadora propõe e é um limite mínimo, não uma recomendação. Abaixo desse nível torna-se difícil obter proteína, vitaminas e minerais suficientes através dos alimentos, por isso uma ingestão menor só deve ser seguida com acompanhamento médico.

schemaFaqs.question: Que fórmula usa esta calculadora de calorias?
schemaFaqs.answer: Mifflin-St Jeor para o metabolismo basal e depois um multiplicador de atividade padrão. Substituiu a antiga equação de Harris-Benedict na prática clínica por ser mais exata para as composições corporais atuais, normalmente dentro de cerca de 10 % em adultos saudáveis.

schemaFaqs.question: Tenho de contar calorias para emagrecer?
schemaFaqs.answer: Não. Contar é apenas uma forma de manter um défice, e muitas pessoas conseguem o mesmo mudando o que comem em vez de o pesarem. Saber onde fica aproximadamente a sua manutenção é útil de qualquer maneira, porque mostra o tamanho real da mudança que está a fazer.

schemaFaqs.question: Esta calculadora de calorias guarda os meus dados?
schemaFaqs.answer: Não. O cálculo é feito inteiramente no seu navegador. Nada do que escrever é enviado para os nossos servidores nem guardado.

schemaFaqs.question: Quantas calorias por dia são recomendadas em Portugal?
schemaFaqs.answer: O valor de referência inscrito nos rótulos alimentares em Portugal é o europeu: 2.000 kcal por dia para um adulto médio. A Roda dos Alimentos do SNS organiza a alimentação em torno de valores desta ordem, mas trata-se de médias populacionais — as suas necessidades dependem da altura, do peso, da idade e do nível de atividade, que é o que a calculadora acima estima.

schemaFaqs.question: Um médico pode rever o meu objetivo calórico?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sim. Uma consulta permite verificar se o valor faz sentido para o seu historial e encaminhá-lo para nutrição quando é preciso um plano alimentar completo. Os nossos médicos registados podem analisar o número por vídeo, juntamente com a tensão arterial, o colesterol e a glicemia.

Fale com um médico antes de alterar a sua ingestão se estiver grávida ou a amamentar, tiver menos de 18 anos ou estiver a ser tratado por alguma doença.01O que significam os seus números de caloriasO número principal é o seu nível de manutenção: aproximadamente o que gasta num dia, já com a atividade contada. Se comer isso, o peso mantém-se onde está.Os objetivos abaixo são o mesmo número com um défice ou um excedente aplicado. Um défice diário de 500 kcal corresponde a cerca de meio quilo por semana, que é o ritmo em que a maioria das recomendações assenta — rápido o suficiente para se notar e lento o suficiente para se aguentar.ManterIngestão diáriaO seu valor de manutençãoO que esperarO peso mantém-se ao longo de semanas, não de diasPerda ligeiraIngestão diáriaManutenção − 250 kcalO que esperarCerca de 0,25 kg por semanaPerda constanteIngestão diáriaManutenção − 500 kcalO que esperarCerca de 0,5 kg por semanaGanhoIngestão diáriaManutenção + 300 kcalO que esperarCerca de 0,25 kg por semana, de preferência com treino de forçaObjetivos diários de calorias a partir da sua manutençãoObjetivoIngestão diáriaO que esperarManterO seu valor de manutençãoO peso mantém-se ao longo de semanas, não de diasPerda ligeiraManutenção − 250 kcalCerca de 0,25 kg por semanaPerda constanteManutenção − 500 kcalCerca de 0,5 kg por semanaGanhoManutenção + 300 kcalCerca de 0,25 kg por semana, de preferência com treino de forçaAqui os objetivos de perda nunca descem abaixo de 1.200 kcal por dia. Abaixo desse valor é difícil cobrir com alimentos as necessidades de proteína, vitaminas e minerais, e uma ingestão tão baixa deve ser acompanhada por um médico.02Como escolher o seu nível de atividadeO multiplicador de atividade é a maior alavanca deste cálculo: para o mesmo corpo, a diferença entre sedentário e extremamente ativo passa das 700 kcal por dia. Conta tudo o que faz, não só o treino — estar de pé, andar, as tarefas de casa e o seu trabalho entram na conta.A maioria das pessoas escolhe um nível acima do real. Se treina três vezes por semana e passa o resto do tempo sentado, é pouco a moderadamente ativo, não muito ativo.Sedentário — trabalho sentado e pouco ou nenhum exercício deliberado.Pouco ativo — exercício ligeiro ou desporto de um a três dias por semana.Moderadamente ativo — exercício moderado de três a cinco dias por semana.Muito ativo — exercício intenso seis ou sete dias por semana.Extremamente ativo — trabalho fisicamente exigente ou treino intenso duas vezes por dia.03Como funciona o cálculoO seu metabolismo basal — o que o corpo gasta em repouso completo — vem da equação de Mifflin-St Jeor: 10 × peso em kg, mais 6,25 × altura em cm, menos 5 × idade, e depois mais 5 nos homens ou menos 161 nas mulheres.Esse valor é multiplicado pelo seu nível de atividade, de 1,2 para sedentário até 1,9 para extremamente ativo. O resultado é o gasto energético total diário — o número de manutenção que aparece no topo.Exemplo prático: um homem de 30 anos, com 180 cm e 80 kg, tem um metabolismo basal de 1.780 kcal. Pouco ativo (× 1,375) são cerca de 2.448 kcal por dia para manter o peso.04O que uma calculadora de calorias não lhe dizTodas as equações aqui usadas são médias populacionais ajustadas a dados medidos, e as pessoas ficam de um lado ou do outro. Encare o número como uma estimativa para testar na balança durante três ou quatro semanas, não como um facto sobre o seu corpo.Na maioria dos adultos a estimativa costuma ficar dentro de cerca de 10 % — são 200 kcal para cada lado num dia de 2.000 kcal.Não diz nada sobre de que são feitas essas calorias, e são a proteína, a fibra e os micronutrientes que decidem se a alimentação se aguenta.Doenças da tiroide, alguns medicamentos e um longo historial de dietas afastam o gasto real da estimativa.Não foi pensada para crianças, para a gravidez ou a amamentação, nem para atletas em blocos de treino exigentes.Subestima pessoas muito musculadas, porque a equação usa o peso total e não a massa magra.O passo seguinteUm número de calorias é um ponto de partida, não um plano. title: ADHD test pro dospělé zdarma | Screening · Global Health
description: Vyplňte šest otázek screeningového testu ADHD pro dospělé. Výsledek není diagnóza; tu stanoví psychiatr nebo klinický psycholog.
h2: Co vám tento screening říct nemůže
Jak se dostat k pořádnému vyšetření

schemaFaqs.question: Může online ADHD test stanovit diagnózu?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ne, a nedokáže to žádný online dotazník. Tohle je screening: rozdělí lidi na ty, u kterých má smysl pořádné vyšetření, a na ty, u kterých to podle těchto odpovědí neplatí. Diagnózu stanoví psychiatr nebo klinický psycholog z úplného rozhovoru o vaší anamnéze, ne ze šesti otázek.

schemaFaqs.question: Co je ASRS?
schemaFaqs.answer: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale, vytvořená ve spolupráci se Světovou zdravotnickou organizací. Část A je zdejší screening o šesti otázkách, celá škála jich má osmnáct. Je to nejrozšířenější screeningový nástroj pro ADHD u dospělých, takže výsledek, který přinesete, lékař zná.

schemaFaqs.question: Jaký výsledek se počítá jako pozitivní?
schemaFaqs.answer: Čtyři a více z šesti otázek zodpovězených na vlastní hranici nebo nad ní. První tři se počítají od odpovědi „někdy“, poslední tři až od „často“ — hranice se liší, protože se liší otázky, a jediná plošná mez by nepozorný typ přehlédla.

schemaFaqs.question: Můžu mít ADHD, i když je výsledek negativní?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ano. Šest otázek nepokryje stav, který se v různém věku a u různých lidí projevuje jinak. Zvlášť nepozorný typ bývá zachycen málo — je to jeden z důvodů, proč ženy dostávají diagnózu později a méně často. Pokud vám potíže komplikují život, negativní screening není důvod přestat se ptát.

schemaFaqs.question: Kdo může diagnostikovat ADHD?
schemaFaqs.answer: Psychiatr nebo klinický psycholog, podle země. Cesta obvykle začíná u praktického lékaře: sebere anamnézu, vyloučí stavy, které ADHD napodobují — štítnou žlázu, poruchy spánku, úzkost, depresi — a odešle vás na samotné vyšetření.

schemaFaqs.question: Ukládá tento ADHD test moje odpovědi?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ne. Vyhodnocení běží celé ve vašem prohlížeči. Nic z toho, co zvolíte, se neodesílá na naše servery ani se neukládá.

schemaFaqs.question: Kde se v Česku vyšetřuje ADHD u dospělých?
schemaFaqs.answer: V psychiatrické ambulanci pro dospělé nebo u klinického psychologa — to jsou odbornosti, které diagnózu stanoví. Praktický lékař bývá prvním krokem: projde s vámi anamnézu, vyloučí stavy, které ADHD připomínají (štítná žláza, spánek, úzkost, deprese), a odešle vás dál.

schemaFaqs.question: Můžu dostat léky na ADHD na základě online testu?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ne, a od nikoho, kdo to nabízí, to neberte. Léky na ADHD podléhají zvláštnímu režimu a nasazují se až po úplném vyšetření a stanovení diagnózy odborníkem. Naši registrovaní lékaři mohou výsledek screeningu probrat, vyloučit stavy, které ho napodobují, a odeslat vás dál — diagnózu po videu nestanoví.

faqs.question: Může online ADHD test stanovit diagnózu?
faqs.answer: Ne, a nedokáže to žádný online dotazník. Tohle je screening: rozdělí lidi na ty, u kterých má smysl pořádné vyšetření, a na ty, u kterých to podle těchto odpovědí neplatí. Diagnózu stanoví psychiatr nebo klinický psycholog z úplného rozhovoru o vaší anamnéze, ne ze šesti otázek.

faqs.question: Co je ASRS?
faqs.answer: Adult ADHD Self-Report Scale, vytvořená ve spolupráci se Světovou zdravotnickou organizací. Část A je zdejší screening o šesti otázkách, celá škála jich má osmnáct. Je to nejrozšířenější screeningový nástroj pro ADHD u dospělých, takže výsledek, který přinesete, lékař zná.

Škála vznikla pro dospělé od 18 let a není screeningem pro děti.02Jak ADHD vypadá u dospělýchADHD v dospělosti málokdy vypadá jako obrázek ze školní lavice. Hyperaktivita se často obrací dovnitř — neklid, hlava, která se nezastaví — zatímco nepozornost zůstává a začíná něco stát: zmeškané termíny, neotevřená úřední pošta, pracovní paměť, které pořád něco vypadne.Pro diagnózu je podstatné, že potíže trvají dlouho, projevují se ve více oblastech života a skutečně omezují. Klíče někam založí každý; na to se tu neptáme.Začít úkoly, na kterých záleží, a dokončit ty, které přestaly být zajímavé.Čas: podceňovat ho, ztrácet ho, chodit pozdě navzdory upřímné snaze.Organizace — papíry, faktury, termíny — stojí mnohem víc sil, než se zdá, že stojí ostatní.Neklid nebo trvalá tichá potřeba něco dělat.Skákat do řeči, vyhrknout něco nebo jednat dřív, než je nápad domyšlený.Emoce, které přijdou rychle a rychle odejdou, často silněji, než by odpovídalo podnětu.03Co vám tento screening říct nemůžeDotazník o šesti otázkách je třídicí nástroj. Je záměrně rychlý a záměrně velkorysý, protože jeho úkolem je rozhodnout, kdo by měl projít pořádným vyšetřením — ne kdo má ADHD.Není to diagnóza. Pozitivní výsledek sám o sobě znamená jen „stojí za vyšetření“.Negativní výsledek ADHD nevylučuje, zvlášť u nepozorného typu a zvlášť u žen, které bývají diagnostikovány později a méně často.Úzkost, deprese, špatný spánek, onemocnění štítné žlázy, chronická bolest i vyšší konzumace alkoholu vedou ke stejným odpovědím.Neodliší ADHD od autismu, od specifické poruchy učení ani od následků dlouhého zátěžového období.Vznikl a byl ověřen pro dospělé. Děti a dospívající potřebují úplně jiné vyšetření.O léčbě neříká nic. Léky jsou jednou z možností a přicházejí na řadu až po diagnóze.04Jak se dostat k pořádnému vyšetřeníDiagnózu ADHD stanoví psychiatr nebo klinický psycholog. Vyšetření je strukturovaný klinický rozhovor o vaší anamnéze od dětství, obvykle s dotazníky a pokud možno i s popisem od někoho, kdo vás dlouho zná.Začněte u lékaře. Projde s vámi anamnézu, vyloučí stavy, které ADHD připomínají, a odešle vás na vyšetření.Vezměte s sebou konkrétní věci, ne skóre: vysvědčení, hodnocení z práce, to, co se opakovaně nedaří, a jak dlouho už to trvá.Řekněte, co dalšího se děje — spánek, nálada, alkohol, štítná žláza, dřívější úraz hlavy. Mění to vyšetření i jeho pořadí.Výsledek screeningu je začátek toho rozhovoru, ne jeho náhrada. Vezměte si ten svůj s sebou.Pokud to nezvládáte nebo máte myšlenky na sebepoškození, obraťte se hned na lékaře nebo na tísňovou linku a nečekejte na vyšetření.Kam dálVýsledek screeningu je důvod nechat se vyšetřit, ne diagnóza. title: Těhotenská kalkulačka | Termín porodu a týdny
description: Odhadněte termín porodu a týden těhotenství podle prvního dne poslední menstruace a délky cyklu. Výsledek je orientační.
h2: Proč datovací ultrazvuk tento odhad nahrazuje

schemaFaqs.question: Jak přesná je kalkulačka termínu porodu?
schemaFaqs.answer: Výpočet je přesný, předpoklady za ním nikoli. Přesně na předpokládaný termín se rodí jen asi jedno těhotenství z dvaceti a velká většina porodů proběhne v týdnech okolo něj. Přesnou verzí je ultrazvuk v prvním trimestru — jakmile ho máte, pracuje se dál s jeho termínem.

schemaFaqs.question: V kolikátém týdnu těhotenství jsem?
schemaFaqs.answer: Týdny se počítají od prvního dne poslední menstruace, ne od početí — proto jste ve chvíli, kdy test poprvé vyjde pozitivně, už asi ve čtvrtém týdnu. K početí dochází přibližně dva týdny po onom prvním dni, takže těhotenství je vždy datováno asi o dva týdny „starší“ než samotný embryonální vývoj.

schemaFaqs.question: Co znamená 9w 3d?
schemaFaqs.answer: Devět dokončených týdnů a tři dny od prvního dne poslední menstruace. Takto se to zapisuje v těhotenské dokumentaci, protože celý týden je příliš hrubý údaj, když má ultrazvuk nebo krevní test proběhnout v konkrétním okně.

schemaFaqs.question: Můžu ji použít, když mám nepravidelný cyklus?
schemaFaqs.answer: Můžete a zadání vaší obvyklé délky cyklu vás dostane blíž než výchozích 28 dnů. Nepravidelný cyklus je ale právě ten případ, kdy je poslední menstruace slabým vodítkem, takže výsledek berte jako orientační, dokud nebudete na ultrazvuku.

schemaFaqs.question: Změní se termín porodu po ultrazvuku?
schemaFaqs.answer: Často ano, obvykle o několik dnů. Ultrazvuk měří miminko místo počítání od zapamatovaného data, a proto platí termín z něj. Rozdíl týdne i více je běžný, když bylo datum poslední menstruace nejisté.

schemaFaqs.question: Ukládá tato kalkulačka moje údaje?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ne. Výpočet probíhá výhradně ve vašem prohlížeči. Nic, co zadáte, se neodesílá na naše servery ani neukládá.

schemaFaqs.question: Jak se v Česku zaregistrovat do prenatální poradny?
schemaFaqs.answer: Přes gynekologa: ten těhotenství potvrdí, převezme vás do prenatální poradny a vede těhotenský průkaz. Tam se také objednává první ultrazvuk, a termín, který z něj vyjde, se dál používá jako ten platný.

schemaFaqs.question: Kdy se v Česku dělá datovací ultrazvuk?
schemaFaqs.answer: První ultrazvuk se obvykle provádí mezi 11. a 14. týdnem, screeningový pak okolo 20. týdne. Do té doby máte k dispozici odhad výše — a naši registrovaní lékaři mohou po videu probrat počáteční příznaky nebo léky, které už berete.

faqs.question: Jak přesná je kalkulačka termínu porodu?
faqs.answer: Výpočet je přesný, předpoklady za ním nikoli. Přesně na předpokládaný termín se rodí jen asi jedno těhotenství z dvaceti a velká většina porodů proběhne v týdnech okolo něj. Přesnou verzí je ultrazvuk v prvním trimestru — jakmile ho máte, pracuje se dál s jeho termínem.

faqs.question: V kolikátém týdnu těhotenství jsem?
faqs.answer: Týdny se počítají od prvního dne poslední menstruace, ne od početí — proto jste ve chvíli, kdy test poprvé vyjde pozitivně, už asi ve čtvrtém týdnu. K početí dochází přibližně dva týdny po onom prvním dni, takže těhotenství je vždy datováno asi o dva týdny „starší“ než samotný embryonální vývoj.

faqs.question: Co znamená 9w 3d?
faqs.answer: Devět dokončených týdnů a tři dny od prvního dne poslední menstruace. Takto se to zapisuje v těhotenské dokumentaci, protože celý týden je příliš hrubý údaj, když má ultrazvuk nebo krevní test proběhnout v konkrétním okně.

faqs.question: Můžu ji použít, když mám nepravidelný cyklus?
faqs.answer: Můžete a zadání vaší obvyklé délky cyklu vás dostane blíž než výchozích 28 dnů. Nepravidelný cyklus je ale právě ten případ, kdy je poslední menstruace slabým vodítkem, takže výsledek berte jako orientační, dokud nebudete na ultrazvuku.

faqs.question: Změní se termín porodu po ultrazvuku?
faqs.answer: Často ano, obvykle o několik dnů. Ultrazvuk měří miminko místo počítání od zapamatovaného data, a proto platí termín z něj. Rozdíl týdne i více je běžný, když bylo datum poslední menstruace nejisté.

faqs.question: Ukládá tato kalkulačka moje údaje?
faqs.answer: Ne. Výpočet probíhá výhradně ve vašem prohlížeči. Nic, co zadáte, se neodesílá na naše servery ani neukládá.

Přesně na předpokládaný termín se rodí jen asi jedno těhotenství z dvaceti.02Jak se termín porodu počítáOdhad vychází z Naegeleho pravidla: 280 dnů, tedy 40 týdnů, od prvního dne poslední menstruace. Předpokládá 28denní cyklus s ovulací okolo 14. dne.Pokud jsou vaše cykly delší nebo kratší, ovulace se posouvá s nimi, a proto kalkulačka posune datum o stejný rozdíl. Cyklus 32 dnů odhad posune o čtyři dny později, cyklus 24 dnů o čtyři dny dříve.Praktický příklad: poslední menstruace začínající 1. ledna při 28denním cyklu dává 8. října. Stejná menstruace při 32denním cyklu dává 12. října.03Proč datovací ultrazvuk tento odhad nahrazujeKalkulačka umí pracovat jen s daty, která jí zadáte. Ultrazvuk měří samotné miminko, a proto se dál pracuje s termínem z ultrazvuku.Spoléhá na to, že si přesně pamatujete první den poslední menstruace.Předpokládá ovulaci v polovině cyklu, což neplatí u každé ženy.Nepravidelný cyklus, nedávno ukončená antikoncepce i kojení dělají z poslední menstruace slabé vodítko.Ultrazvuk v prvním trimestru měří miminko, obvykle mezi 11. a 14. týdnem, s odchylkou několika dnů.Po IVF se datuje podle dne transferu, ne podle menstruace, takže tento odhad neplatí.04Kdy kontaktovat lékařeMyslíte si, že jste těhotná, a ještě nemáte zajištěnou prenatální péči — první prohlídka i datovací ultrazvuk patří na začátek.Máte v časném těhotenství krvácení, křeče nebo bolest na jedné straně.Máte silné nebo trvalé zvracení, případně v sobě neudržíte tekutiny.Máte chronické onemocnění nebo pravidelně berete léky — některé je potřeba přehodnotit hned po potvrzení těhotenství.Jste ve 41. týdnu, nebo máte po termínu a pohyby miminka se změnily.Kam dálOdhadovaný termín je začátek těhotenské péče, ne celá péče. description: Consulte hoy con un médico colegiado por videollamada — medicina general, certificados médicos, derivaciones a especialistas. Mismo día en España.
h2: Atención para lo que realmente está pasando.
Hecha para personas que no deberían tener que esperar.

El médico que reserva es el médico que le atiende.
Reserva atención con un médico que tú elijas.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cómo funciona una consulta online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Reserve una cita online, elija un horario disponible y únase a su consulta por videollamada segura desde su teléfono u ordenador. Su médico revisará sus síntomas e historial y le aconsejará los siguientes pasos.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Quiénes son los médicos?
schemaFaqs.answer: Todos los médicos de Global Health son colegiados a través de Organización Médica Colegial (colegios de médicos). Los datos de colegiación se muestran en el perfil de cada médico.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Qué idiomas están disponibles?
schemaFaqs.answer: Las consultas están disponibles en varios idiomas, según disponibilidad del médico. Puede elegir médico por idioma al reservar.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Es segura una consulta online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sí. Todas las consultas se realizan mediante videollamada segura conforme a los estándares nacionales de telemedicina, y su información clínica se trata de forma confidencial.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cómo reservo una cita?
schemaFaqs.answer: Elija un servicio, seleccione un horario disponible y complete su reserva online. Recibirá confirmación por correo electrónico antes de la cita.

schemaFaqs.question: ¿Cuánto cuesta una consulta?
schemaFaqs.answer: Las consultas en Global Health cuestan desde 29,00 €. Sin costes ocultos ni suscripción obligatoria.

María Fernanda Ocampo MoraCGCOM | 291409735SpanishLa Dra. María Fernanda Ocampo Mora es médica con amplia experiencia en medicina de urgencias, medicina general y familiar, y medicina estética, una clínica que combina la solidez de quien ha trabajado en hospitales de alta complejidad con la sensibilidad estética y la precisión de quien ha formado a nivel de maestría en medicina estética avanzada. Se graduó como médica en la Universidad Libre de Cali y ha desarrollado su carrera en entornos hospitalarios de alto nivel en España y Colombia. En España ha trabajado en el Hospital Quirón Málaga y el Hospital Quirón Marbella, dos de los centros hospitalarios privados de mayor prestigio del país, proporcionando atención médica urgente, diagnóstico rápido y atención multidisciplinar en situaciones críticas. En Colombia acumuló años de experiencia en unidades de cuidados intensivos (UCI) y servicios de urgencias, atendiendo pacientes críticos y casos médicos complejos. Paralelamente a su práctica hospitalaria, la Dra. Ocampo ha desarrollado una trayectoria sólida en medicina estética, con un Máster en Medicina Estética y un Máster en Tratamientos Faciales con formación académica europea certificada. Actualmente ejerce en Clínica IOX Marbella y Clínica Vasari, donde combina procedimientos mínimamente invasivos, tratamientos faciales y corporales y protocolos de tratamiento personalizados con los más altos estándares de seguridad médica. Su formación en urgencias y UCI le proporciona un criterio clínico de alta fiabilidad, la capacidad de evaluar rápidamente si un síntoma es banal o requiere atención inmediata, que es especialmente valiosa en una consulta online donde la toma de decisiones en tiempo real marca la diferencia. La consulta estética online con la Dra. Ocampo es la evaluación médica y la fase de planificación personalizada que debe preceder a cualquier procedimiento. Su enfoque La Dra. Ocampo combina la precisión clínica de una médica formada en urgencias y UCI con un enfoque preventivo, holístico y empático. Prioriza la seguridad del paciente, la ética profesional y el desarrollo continuo, y cree que la atención médica de calidad no es incompatible con ser cercana y accesible. schemaFaqs.answer: Rezervujte si termín online, vyberte dostupný čas a připojte se ke konzultaci prostřednictvím zabezpečeného videa z telefonu nebo počítače. Lékař posoudí vaše příznaky a anamnézu a doporučí další postup.

schemaFaqs.question: Kdo jsou lékaři?
schemaFaqs.answer: Všichni lékaři na Global Health jsou registrovaní u Česká lékařská komora (ČLK). Registrační údaje jsou uvedeny na profilu každého lékaře.

schemaFaqs.question: Jaké jazyky jsou k dispozici?
schemaFaqs.answer: Konzultace jsou dostupné ve více jazycích podle dostupnosti lékaře. Lékaře podle jazyka si můžete vybrat při rezervaci.

schemaFaqs.question: Je online konzultace bezpečná?
schemaFaqs.answer: Ano. Všechny konzultace probíhají prostřednictvím zabezpečeného videa v souladu s národními standardy telemedicíny a vaše zdravotní údaje jsou zpracovávány důvěrně.

Book an online video consultation.Klinický ředitelPraktický lékařMUDr. Vojtěch ČernýČLK | 1172330197English, CzechMUDr. Vojtěch Černý je lékař, absolvent oboru Všeobecné lékařství na 2. lékařské fakultě Univerzity Karlovy v Praze, jedné z nejprestižnějších lékařských institucí v České republice, s klinickými zkušenostmi v oblasti urgentní medicíny, vnitřního lékařství, chirurgie a primární péče v předních českých nemocnicích a záchranných službách. Před zaměřením na primární péči budoval MUDr. Černý svůj klinický základ v některých z nejnáročnějších prostředí v zemi, včetně Fakultní nemocnice Motol, Nemocnice Na Bulovce, Masarykovy nemocnice v Ústí nad Labem a FN Plzeň, kde působil na urgentních příjmech, interních a chirurgických odděleních, v ambulantní péči, očkovacích centrech a přednemocniční záchranné službě, včetně podpory letecké záchranné služby. Díky těmto zkušenostem z akutní medicíny dokáže rychle rozpoznat, kdy si stav vyžaduje neodkladnou péči, a kdy nikoli. Dnes jako praktický lékař Global Health Česká republika poskytuje MUDr. Černý primární péči prvního kontaktu prostřednictvím zabezpečené video konzultace. Zároveň pokračuje v doktorském studiu v oboru Preventivní medicína a epidemiologie na 1. lékařské fakultě Univerzity Karlovy a je držitelem titulu MBA v oblasti Healthcare Management a LL.M. v obchodním právu, kombinace, která mu dává výjimečné porozumění jak klinickým, tak organizačním aspektům moderního zdravotnictví. Online medicíně se věnuje proto, že věří, že přístup ke kvalitní lékařské péči by neměl záviset na místě bydliště, čekacích dobách ani administrativních překážkách. Klinická rozhodnutí zůstávají zcela v pravomoci lékaře po provedeném posouzení.Naši lékaři běžně nepředepisují návykové látky prostřednictvím online konzultací.Online konzultace nejsou vhodné pro řešení zdravotních pohotovostních stavů. Pokud se nacházíte v život ohrožující situaci, neprodleně kontaktujte záchrannou službu na čísle 112 nebo vyhledejte nejbližší pohotovost.

title: Medic Online România | Medici și Specialiști Înregistrați
description: Consultații medicale online în România, în română sau engleză. Alegeți medicul și verificați orele disponibile la programare.
h2: Îngrijire pentru ce se întâmplă cu adevărat.
Construită pentru oameni care nu ar trebui să aștepte.
Evaluat de pacienți reali pe Doctify
De ce să alegeți Global Health
Medicul pe care îl rezervați este medicul pe care îl vedeți.
Programați îngrijire cu un clinician ales de dvs.

schemaFaqs.question: Cum funcționează o consultație online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Rezervați o programare online, alegeți o oră disponibilă și alăturați-vă consultației prin video securizat de pe telefon sau computer. Medicul va evalua simptomele și istoricul dumneavoastră și va recomanda pașii următori.

schemaFaqs.question: Cine sunt medicii?
schemaFaqs.answer: Toți medicii de pe Global Health sunt înregistrați la Colegiul Medicilor din România. Detaliile de înregistrare sunt afișate pe profilul fiecărui medic.

schemaFaqs.question: Ce limbi sunt disponibile?
schemaFaqs.answer: Consultațiile sunt disponibile în mai multe limbi, în funcție de disponibilitatea medicului. Puteți alege medicul în funcție de limbă la rezervare.

schemaFaqs.question: Este sigură o consultație online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Da. Toate consultațiile se desfășoară prin video securizat, conform standardelor naționale de telemedicină, iar informațiile dumneavoastră clinice sunt tratate confidențial.

schemaFaqs.question: Cum rezerv o programare?
schemaFaqs.answer: Alegeți un serviciu, selectați o oră disponibilă și finalizați rezervarea online. Veți primi o confirmare prin email înainte de programare.

schemaFaqs.question: Cât costă o consultație?
schemaFaqs.answer: Consultațiile la Global Health costă de la 65,00 RON. Fără costuri ascunse, fără abonament obligatoriu.

Are experiență clinică în România și Irlanda. A absolvit Facultatea de Medicină a Universității de Medicină și Farmacie din Craiova și a efectuat rezidențiatul în ATI la Spitalul Clinic de Urgență Floreasca din București, unul dintre cele mai active spitale de urgență din România. Și-a continuat formarea în Irlanda ca medic registrator ATI la Spitalul Universitar Tallaght și la Spitalul Universitar Mater Misericordiae din Dublin. În prezent practică la un spital de nivel IV din București, cel mai înalt nivel de complexitate din sistemul românesc. Pregătirea în terapie intensivă nu înseamnă că Dr. Brînduș tratează doar urgențe. Înseamnă că știe exact când ceva este urgent și când nu, una dintre cele mai valoroase abilități într-o consultație online, unde evaluarea precisă a situației clinice este esențială. Deține Diploma Europeană în Anestezie și Terapie Intensivă (EDAIC), Partea I. schemaFaqs.question: Como funciona uma consulta online?
schemaFaqs.answer: Marque uma consulta online, escolha um horário disponível e junte-se à sua consulta por vídeo seguro a partir do telemóvel ou computador. O seu médico irá rever os seus sintomas e historial e aconselhar os próximos passos.

schemaFaqs.question: Quem são os médicos?
schemaFaqs.answer: Todos os médicos da Global Health estão inscritos em Conselho Federal de Medicina (CFM) / CRM. Os dados de inscrição são apresentados no perfil de cada médico.

schemaFaqs.question: Que idiomas estão disponíveis?
schemaFaqs.answer: As consultas estão disponíveis em vários idiomas, consoante a disponibilidade do médico. Pode escolher o médico por idioma ao marcar.

schemaFaqs.question: Uma consulta online é segura?
schemaFaqs.answer: Sim. Todas as consultas são realizadas por vídeo seguro de acordo com as normas nacionais de telemedicina, e as suas informações clínicas são tratadas de forma confidencial.

schemaFaqs.question: Como marco uma consulta?
schemaFaqs.answer: Escolha um serviço, selecione um horário disponível e conclua a marcação online. Receberá uma confirmação por email antes da consulta.

Book an online video consultation.Diretor ClínicoMédico de Família e ComunidadeDr. Renato SarmentoCRM | 170837Portuguese, English, SpanishO Dr. Renato Ziviani Sarmento é médico de família e comunidade com mais de dez anos de experiência nos sistemas público e suplementar de saúde, com atuação consolidada em Atenção Primária à Saúde (APS), Cuidados Paliativos e Telemedicina, uma combinação rara que o posiciona como um dos profissionais mais completos disponíveis para consulta online no Brasil. Graduado em Medicina pelo Centro Universitário do Estado do Pará, completou sua Residência Médica em Medicina de Família e Comunidade na Casa de Saúde Santa Marcelina, referência nacional em Saúde da Família em São Paulo. Aprofundou sua formação em Cuidados Paliativos com especialização no Centro Universitário São Camilo e, mais recentemente, concluiu um Mestrado em Cuidados Paliativos pela Universidad Pontificia de Salamanca (Espanha), formação europeia de alto nível que enriquece sua prática com uma perspetiva internacional. É também MBA em Gestão, Inovação e Serviços em Saúde pela PUC-RS. Atualmente atua em telemedicina integrada à Atenção Básica, com experiência em modelo híbrido de Consultório Digital dentro de Unidade Básica de Saúde da Estratégia Saúde da Família em São Paulo, um dos formatos mais inovadores de telemedicina no SUS, além de experiência em plataformas de Pronto Atendimento Digital para a saúde suplementar, atendendo pacientes de todas as idades e regiões do Brasil. Os atendimentos pela Global Health são realizados por meio da Pallium Cuidados Integrados LTDA (CNPJ: 35.020.828/0001-96). Sua experiência como coordenador médico do Programa Melhor em Casa do Hospital Santa Marcelina, supervisionando equipes multiprofissionais de atenção domiciliar, conduzindo discussões clínicas, gerindo indicadores e integrando redes de cuidado, traduz-se em uma visão sistêmica da saúde que vai muito além da consulta individual. O Dr. Renato entende o cuidado como um processo longitudinal, e não como uma série de atendimentos isolados. Para pacientes com doenças crônicas, condições complexas ou que enfrentam situações de fim de vida, a combinação de Medicina de Família e Cuidados Paliativos é especialmente valiosa: significa um médico que sabe cuidar da pessoa inteira, não apenas da doença, e que tem formação específica para acompanhar os momentos mais difíceis da vida com competência clínica e humanidade. O que trata Medicina de família e atenção primária: doenças agudas, gestão de condições crônicas, promoção e prevenção em saúde Doenças crônicas: hipertensão, diabetes, dislipidemia, hipotireoidismo, asma, DPOC Cuidados Paliativos: suporte a pacientes com doenças avançadas, controle de sintomas, suporte à família, qualidade de vida Acompanhamento de doenças oncológicas avançadas: suporte paliativo, controle de dor e sintomas Saúde da mulher, do homem e do idoso: acompanhamento longitudinal e preventivo Saúde mental: ansiedade, depressão, manejo do estresse e encaminhamento a especialistas Pós-hospitalização e transição de cuidados: acompanhamento após alta hospitalar, prevenção de reintegrações Saúde digital e teleconsulta: orientações sobre uso de tecnologias de saúde, monitoramento remoto Atestados médicos, declarações e encaminhamentos Renovação de receitas e revisão de medicações Sua abordagem: O Dr. Renato pratica uma medicina centrada na pessoa, não no diagnóstico isolado, mas no contexto de vida, nas prioridades e nos valores de quem está sendo cuidado. Sua formação em Cuidados Paliativos aprofundou essa visão: independentemente da condição clínica, toda consulta deve terminar com o paciente sentindo que foi ouvido, que entendeu o que está acontecendo com ele e que tem um plano claro para os próximos passos.Marcar com RenatoVer perfilNo doctors found.Why Global HealthPorquê escolher a Global HealthMédicos inscritos em Conselho Federal de Medicina (CFM) / CRMConsultas por vídeo seguras, realizadas de acordo com as normas nacionais de telemedicinaHorários disponíveis apresentados durante a marcação, consoante a disponibilidade do médicoConsultas disponíveis em vários idiomas, consoante a disponibilidade do médicoDocumentação clínica e orientação de seguimento enviadas por email após cada consultaPreços transparentes — sem custos ocultos, sem subscrição obrigatóriaProfissionais médicos verificadosO médico que marca é o médico que o atende.Cada clínico na plataforma é identificado, fotografado e inscrito no Conselho Federal de Medicina. title: Online Doctor Ireland | IMC-Registered GPs & Specialists | Same Day
description: See an IMC-registered doctor by video call today for GP consultations, sick certs and specialist referrals. Same-day appointments anywhere in Ireland from €39.
h1: Online Doctor Ireland | IMC-registered physicians, same day.
h2: Built for people who shouldn't have to wait.
Rated by real patients on Doctify
Will I see the same doctor every time?
The doctor you book is the doctor you see.
Partners supporting care in this market.
Book care with a clinician you choose.

schemaFaqs.question: How does an online consultation work?
schemaFaqs.answer: Book an appointment online, choose a time that suits you, and join your consultation by secure video from your phone, tablet, or computer. No app download required. At the start of the call, your doctor will ask about your symptoms, medical history, and any medication you are currently taking, then carry out a clinical assessment based on what you describe and show if needed, such as a rash or injury, over video. Based on that assessment, your doctor may offer advice on managing your condition, request follow-up tests, refer you to a specialist, or issue a prescription or medical certificate. Always at their professional discretion and only when clinically appropriate. After your consultation, you will receive a written summary by email covering what was discussed, any recommendations made, and clear next steps, so you have a record to keep or to share with another doctor if you ever need to.

schemaFaqs.question: Who are the doctors?
schemaFaqs.answer: All doctors on Global Health are registered with the relevant national medical council for the country you are booking in, for example, the Irish Medical Council in Ireland, meaning they have met the required standards of qualification, training, and ongoing professional practice to treat patients there. Each doctor's registration details are shown directly on their profile, so you can verify their credentials before you book, rather than taking it on trust. Profiles also include information about a doctor's specialty, languages spoken, and areas of clinical focus, helping you choose the right doctor for your needs. Doctors on our platform work across general practice and a range of specialties, including cardiology, dermatology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, neurology, and gynaecology, among others. Every consultation is led entirely by the treating doctor's own clinical judgement. Decisions about advice, referrals, prescriptions, or certificates are always made by the doctor, based on their assessment of you.

schemaFaqs.question: Which languages are available?
schemaFaqs.answer: Consultations at Global Health are available in six languages, English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, Romanian, and German, so you can speak with a doctor in the language you are most comfortable with, subject to clinician availability at the time you book. When you search for an appointment, you can filter the list of doctors by the language they speak, alongside factors like specialty and appointment time, so you only see doctors who match what you are looking for. Each doctor's profile also states clearly which languages they consult in, so you know before you book. This matters for more than convenience: being able to describe your symptoms and understand your doctor's advice in your own language helps ensure nothing is lost during a clinical conversation. If your preferred language is not available at a given time, you can choose another slot or check back later.

schemaFaqs.question: Is an online consultation secure?
schemaFaqs.answer: Yes. Every consultation at Global Health takes place over encrypted, secure video conducted to national telemedicine standards, so your conversation with your doctor stays private between the two of you. Consultations are not recorded, and your video call exists only for the duration of the appointment itself. Any clinical information you share, your symptoms, history, and the notes your doctor makes, is stored securely and handled in line with GDPR and applicable national data protection law, with access limited to the clinicians involved in your care. You have rights over your own data, including the right to request a copy of your medical records or ask how your information is used and stored. Our booking and payment systems follow the same security standards as other regulated healthcare providers. If you ever have concerns about privacy, our support team can explain exactly how your information is protected.

schemaFaqs.question: How do I book an appointment?
schemaFaqs.answer: Choose the type of consultation you need, a GP appointment, a specialist review, or a guided health test, and you will see the next available time slots based on real doctor availability, including same-day appointments in many cases. Select a slot, enter your details, and complete payment securely online; no membership or subscription is required, and you only pay for the consultation you book. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation email straight away with your appointment time, the video link you will use to join, and simple instructions for what to do beforehand, such as having your ID or a list of current medications ready. You can access your appointment details at any time from your patient account, and you will receive a reminder ahead of your consultation, so nothing catches you off guard.

schemaFaqs.question: How much does a consultation cost?
schemaFaqs.answer: Consultations at Global Health cost from €29.00. There are no hidden fees and no membership required.

Book an online video consultation.Clinical DirectorGeneral PractitionerDr Tiago Miguel FigueiraIMC | 523449· General DivisionEnglish, Portuguese, Spanish, FrenchDr. Tiago Miguel Figueira is a Doctor of Medicine (MUDr.) graduated in General Medicine from Masaryk University, Faculty of Medicine in Brno, one of Europe's most internationally recognised medical schools, with clinical experience across Portugal, Ireland and Czechia. Before dedicating himself fully to online medicine, Dr. Figueira served as a Senior House Officer in General Surgery at Tipperary University Hospital in Ireland, gaining hands-on experience in acute care, perioperative medicine, surgical assistance and emergency response. This hospital background gives him the clinical foundation to recognise when something needs urgent attention, and when it doesn't. Today, as Clinical Director of Global Health Ireland and Portugal, Dr. Figueira leads the delivery of online primary care across both markets, from Dublin to Lisbon and everywhere in between. He became an online doctor because he believes that quality healthcare should be available to everyone, regardless of where they live, what language they speak, or how long they can wait. As part of Global Health Ireland and Portugal, Dr. Figueira offers online GP consultations available today, including same-day appointments for acute illness, prescription renewals, sick notes, and medical certificates. His consultations are available to patients across Dublin, Ireland and Portugal and are legally valid for prescriptions at any Irish or Portuguese pharmacy. What he treats Acute illness: respiratory infections, fever, flu, sore throat, ear infections Urinary tract infections and sexual health Chronic disease management: hypertension, diabetes, thyroid disorders, high cholesterol Dermatological concerns: eczema, acne, rashes, allergic reactions Men's and women's health: contraception, hormonal concerns, men's health Preventive care: health assessments, lifestyle counselling, screening referrals Travel health: pre-travel consultations, vaccination advice, travel prescriptions Weight management: evidence-based medical approach including GLP-1 assessment Mental health: anxiety, depression, stress management and specialist referral Sick notes, medical certificates and prescription renewals His approach Every consultation with Dr. Figueira is personalised, evidence-based and delivered with the same clinical standard you would expect from an in-person appointment. He takes the time to listen, explain clearly and ensure you leave the consultation with a clear plan, not just a prescription. Receive notes or next steps when clinically appropriate after the appointment.QuestionsFAQsHow does an online consultation work?Book an appointment online, choose a time that suits you, and join your consultation by secure video from your phone, tablet, or computer. No app download required. At the start of the call, your doctor will ask about your symptoms, medical history, and any medication you are currently taking, then carry out a clinical assessment based on what you describe and show if needed, such as a rash or injury, over video. Based on that assessment, your doctor may offer advice on managing your condition, request follow-up tests, refer you to a specialist, or issue a prescription or medical certificate. Always at their professional discretion and only when clinically appropriate. After your consultation, you will receive a written summary by email covering what was discussed, any recommendations made, and clear next steps, so you have a record to keep or to share with another doctor if you ever need to.Who are the doctors?All doctors on Global Health are registered with the relevant national medical council for the country you are booking in, for example, the Irish Medical Council in Ireland, meaning they have met the required standards of qualification, training, and ongoing professional practice to treat patients there. Each doctor's registration details are shown directly on their profile, so you can verify their credentials before you book, rather than taking it on trust. Profiles also include information about a doctor's specialty, languages spoken, and areas of clinical focus, helping you choose the right doctor for your needs. Doctors on our platform work across general practice and a range of specialties, including cardiology, dermatology, endocrinology, gastroenterology, neurology, and gynaecology, among others. Every consultation is led entirely by the treating doctor's own clinical judgement. Decisions about advice, referrals, prescriptions, or certificates are always made by the doctor, based on their assessment of you.Which languages are available?Consultations at Global Health are available in six languages, English, Portuguese, Spanish, Czech, Romanian, and German, so you can speak with a doctor in the language you are most comfortable with, subject to clinician availability at the time you book. When you search for an appointment, you can filter the list of doctors by the language they speak, alongside factors like specialty and appointment time, so you only see doctors who match what you are looking for. Each doctor's profile also states clearly which languages they consult in, so you know before you book. This matters for more than convenience: being able to describe your symptoms and understand your doctor's advice in your own language helps ensure nothing is lost during a clinical conversation. If your preferred language is not available at a given time, you can choose another slot or check back later.Is an online consultation secure?Yes. Every consultation at Global Health takes place over encrypted, secure video conducted to national telemedicine standards, so your conversation with your doctor stays private between the two of you. Consultations are not recorded, and your video call exists only for the duration of the appointment itself. Any clinical information you share, your symptoms, history, and the notes your doctor makes, is stored securely and handled in line with GDPR and applicable national data protection law, with access limited to the clinicians involved in your care. You have rights over your own data, including the right to request a copy of your medical records or ask how your information is used and stored. Our booking and payment systems follow the same security standards as other regulated healthcare providers. If you ever have concerns about privacy, our support team can explain exactly how your information is protected.How do I book an appointment?Choose the type of consultation you need, a GP appointment, a specialist review, or a guided health test, and you will see the next available time slots based on real doctor availability, including same-day appointments in many cases. Select a slot, enter your details, and complete payment securely online; no membership or subscription is required, and you only pay for the consultation you book. Once your booking is confirmed, you will receive a confirmation email straight away with your appointment time, the video link you will use to join, and simple instructions for what to do beforehand, such as having your ID or a list of current medications ready. You can access your appointment details at any time from your patient account, and you will receive a reminder ahead of your consultation, so nothing catches you off guard.How much does a consultation cost?Consultations at Global Health cost from €29.00. There are no hidden fees and no membership required.LiveChoose from open clinician calendars.Book care with a clinician you choose.Browse licensed doctors registered with national medical councils across Europe, then choose an open appointment time where availability is shown.Book AppointmentView doctorsMedical disclaimerAll medical services provided through Global Health are delivered by doctors registered with Irish Medical Council.Our online doctors conduct remote clinical assessments and may provide treatment recommendations, referrals, or medical certificates only where clinically appropriate and at the treating doctor's professional discretion. Clinical decisions remain entirely at the doctor's discretion following assessment.Our doctors do not routinely prescribe controlled substances through online consultations.Online consultations are not suitable for medical emergencies. If you are experiencing a medical emergency, please contact emergency services immediately by calling 112 or attend your nearest emergency department.
